integrity: The proof treats all independent edge allocations and verifies equality conditions; finite computation is supplementary and does not establish infinite-dimensional quantifiers. Prior methods and spectra are credited, while no authorship or independent certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform-vertex-mass symmetric continuous-time wheel Laplacians, two class-uniform prices, n at least four, a linear unit conductance budget and the spectral gap. Not a discrete-time SLEM or resistance optimum. Historical equivalence in an unlocated source is possible.
title: Quadratic spoke-price frontier for fastest mixing on wheels
